summary: Careful, well‑documented preregistered paired study that executed as declared and honestly reports a degenerate null outcome (no validator failures under shared_initial_candidate semantics). Strong reproducibility artifacts archived. Main defects are editorial and disclosure-formatting: the References section needs conventional IEEE bibliographic formatting and a few entries contain placeholder/ambiguous metadata; the Disclosure Statement should be condensed to avoid repeating execution-log detail while preserving the mandatory master_prompt locator+SHA. No undisclosed preregistration deviations or unsupported scientific claims were found; the manuscript correctly interprets the ceiling effect and limits its conclusions accordingly.
critical_issues: References are not presented as a conventional IEEE bibliography with complete bibliographic metadata for every cited record; several entries contain ambiguous or placeholder venue metadata (e.g., "Comput. Linguistics (or equivalent)"). This violates the submission requirements and must be fixed using the verified reference records archived with the run.

Disclosure Statement currently repeats execution/log-level details and internal artifact references beyond the single mandatory master_prompt locator+SHA. The Disclosure must be condensed and avoid duplicating execution-manifest content; it must retain exactly one master_prompt locator and its SHA‑256 as required.

One manuscript reference entry style (mixture of raw arXiv/DOI tokens and incomplete venue metadata) needs correction so each cited record clearly supports the proximate scholarly claim with full bibliographic fields (authors, title, venue, year).
required_revisions: Replace the References section with a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography using the archived, verified bibliographic metadata for each cited record (authors, full title, venue, year, and DOI/identifier as an auxiliary field). Resolve ambiguous placeholder items (e.g., "(or equivalent)") by supplying the verified venue metadata from the archived reference verification record.

Condense the Disclosure Statement so it is concise and avoids reproducing execution logs, per-file paths, or full per-file hashes. Preserve exactly one immutable master_prompt locator path and its SHA‑256 digest (provenance/master_prompt.txt and the supplied SHA‑256) and otherwise refer to the archived execution manifest/artifacts without listing internal paths or detailed hashes in the manuscript prose.

Fix any remaining bibliographic inconsistencies so that every in-text IEEE numeric citation corresponds to a complete reference entry that supports the nearby claim; use the verified bibliography bundle to source missing metadata.
optional_revisions: Add a single clarifying sentence in Methods noting that the degenerate bootstrap CI and McNemar outcome are a direct consequence of zero discordant pairs and briefly note the interpretive limits of exact tests in that corner case (the Discussion already addresses this, but a concise explicit sentence in Methods would help readers).

If space permits, include one short exemplar validator trace excerpt (already archived) as a small inset or footnote to illustrate the validator's decision criteria; otherwise keep it archived and cite its artifact path in the supplementary materials only.
